intelligence.human_view: Until now the Real Object Law was a rule about how things look — real objects, not flat shapes. His word gives it its why: quality is what makes people believe. When an official piece looks so for real, people take you for real — they want to be part of it, they want it, they respect it. The quality is not polish on top of the product; it is the proof of the product. A system that looks premium is a system people trust to be premium, and a system that looks flat is a system people dismiss before they ever use it. That is why nothing less than the highest quality is acceptable, all the way through — not on the hero page, not on the certificate, everywhere.
intelligence.simple_view: When something looks SO real and SO beautiful, people believe it's real — and they want to be part of it! That's why everything has to be the very best, all the way through!
intelligence.grandma_view: When something looks SO real and SO beautiful, dear, people believe it's real — and they want to be part of it! That's why everything has to be the very best, all the way through!
